review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review, not complete clause or ADR certification. Handoff draft statements are superseded by parent findings and gate-results.

decisions.review: reaffirmed as an explicit, owner-confirmed departure
decisions.basis: Table 15's shall-ignore rule for entries whose object number is greater than /Size is not implemented; the ledger marks §7.5.5 departed. ADR 2346 compares obeying the rule with the current §C.4 repair path and records the project owner's 2026-10-28 choice of robustness. This shard did not reproduce the census/benchmarks and does not relabel the behavior conforming.

§7.5.6's most-recent-copy rule and §7.5.8.3's unknown-type-to-null rule require free/unknown entries to remain explicit answers that block older entries. `Option<Location>` and the xref ordering implement that distinction. The existing exact-update and unknown-type fixtures target it. Its hybrid test fixture has a separate conformance flaw noted in findings.txt.

Stable sort plus first duplicate retained preserves precedence only because the collected input order is newest section, then same-section XRefStm, then older section. Current `read_from_startxref` has that order, matching §7.5.8.4. The parent should replace/review the malformed hybrid witness before treating the hybrid assertion as source-backed validation.

The erratum strikes the printed default byte offset 0 for Table 18 type 1; Table 17 says use a field default only if one exists. `entry_location` rejects type 1 records whose W has no second field, and the assertion calibrates rebuild/refusal. Separate from the technically questionable zero-first-width fixture noted as unreviewed below.

decisions.review: reaffirmed as recovery policy, not valid-file requirement
decisions.basis: The reader distinguishes an explicit free/type-0 entry from a section header that declared an entry but whose malformed/truncated section failed to provide it. §C.4 permits a processor to attempt a table rebuild; this recovery does not certify behavior on a conforming section.

The serializer writes type-2 entries and requires xref streams when object streams are generated, as Table 18 requires. Its output has readback plus foreign-reader assertions; this shard did not re-audit all optimization policy or measured size limits.
